3. Improvement chips (bottom 12–14%): Render exactly three evenly spaced rounded chips containing the three phrases inside {개선 포인트}, each chip with either white text on lime fill or dark text on pale fill depending on contrast, using lime accent styling for emphasis. Add small check icons or dot markers inside each chip only if they do not alter the three exact phrases.
4. Footer card-news details: Add a slim footer line with small Korean CTA text such as "저장하고 다시 보기", a tiny handle "@change.note", a page indicator "01 / 05", and small save/share micro icons. These footer details should feel like real social editorial metadata and remain secondary to the comparison.

[4. STYLE RULES]

- Color palette: White (#FFFFFF), lime (#C7EA46), deep charcoal (#1F1F1F), soft gray (#E9ECEF), and muted black (#111111) for high readability.
- Border/shadow: Soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity on the photo frames and chips; thin 1px gray border for structure; use subtle lime keylines, small editorial dividers, and light printed-card texture for realism.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: N/A for graphic layout; prioritize even brightness and high legibility across both comparison panels, with soft realistic shadows under frames and chips.
- Color grade: Clean neutral whites with lime accent highlights and a light editorial infographic tone; photos should retain natural contrast and realistic color rather than looking flat.

[6. MOOD]
Polished Korean lifestyle card-news comparison page — like a real social magazine carousel slide with before/after photography, editorial metadata, tactile paper texture, and a sharp presentation-ready layout.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{상단 문구}", "{제목}", and all three phrases inside "{개선 포인트}" must appear exactly as written.
- English text accuracy: "BEFORE" and "AFTER" must be spelled exactly and consistently.
- Added Korean microcopy should be clean and readable, including examples such as "비교 리포트", "변화 전", "변화 후", "저장하고 다시 보기", "VOL.1198 · 2026.05", "@change.note", and "01 / 05".

- Chips: Exactly three improvement chips must be shown, each derived from the three items in {개선 포인트}.

- Broken Korean characters

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]

2. Middle tracker grid (middle 56%): build a polished table with 5 routine rows derived from {루틴 항목}; each row has a left-aligned routine label, a small memo dot or priority marker, and a right-side checkbox area repeated across {기간} days, with crisp grid lines, evenly spaced cells, and a few example check marks lightly printed in sage to show realistic use.
3. Column header strip: place a compact day/period header row above the check grid, clearly indicating the {기간} tracking period. Include small Korean weekday markers such as "월 화 수 목 금 토 일" where appropriate, a tiny legend "□ 예정  ✓ 완료  △ 조정", and a narrow progress strip labeled "완료율".
4. Side and detail elements: add a slim left margin index with small labels "루틴", "체크", "메모", plus a tiny page marker "P.01" and a corner tab reading "DAILY ROUTINE" in small lettering. Include subtle decorative dividers, dotted guide lines, and lightly tinted section labels using {컬러 톤}.
5. Bottom reward section (bottom 22%): place {보상 문구} centered inside a soft rounded reward box with gentle emphasis. Add a small reflection area titled "이번 기간의 한 줄 기록" with two ruled lines, a tiny checklist summary "성공한 날 / 놓친 날 / 다시 시작", and a closing encouragement line in Korean such as "완벽보다 지속이 더 중요해요".
6. Overall structure: maintain a real printable planner hierarchy with clean alignment, visible paper texture, functional labels, decorative but restrained stationery accents, and readable Korean typography throughout.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Title uses Pretendard ExtraBold, 52–64px feel; body and table text use Noto Sans KR Regular/Medium, 22–28px feel; metadata and micro labels use Noto Sans KR Medium, 12–18px feel; footer note uses Noto Sans KR Medium with slight letter spacing for clarity.

- Border/shadow: thin sage green grid lines, soft rounded section boxes, subtle paper edge shadow, 2px y-offset, 8px blur, 8% opacity, plus faint binder-hole shadows and realistic printed ink texture.

- Lighting: soft diffused overhead studio lighting, even illumination from above with gentle natural shadows under the paper edge, binder holes, tape, and nearby stationery.
- Color grade: clean white base with soft sage accents, slightly muted and stationery-like, inspired by premium Korean planner inserts and warm Japanese paper goods.
- Material realism: visible fiber grain, crisp printed grid ink, slight paper curl at one corner, fine shadow separation from the desk surface, and tactile matte stationery finish.

[6. MOOD]
Calm Korean desk-planner aesthetic — organized, warm, realistic, motivating, and content-rich like a thoughtfully designed routine insert from a premium stationery shop.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{제목}", "{루틴 항목}", "{기간}", "{보상 문구}" must appear exactly and clearly, with no broken Korean characters.
- Include readable Korean micro text such as "기간: {기간}", "완료율", "이번 기간의 한 줄 기록", "월 화 수 목 금 토 일", and "완벽보다 지속이 더 중요해요".
- Checkboxes must be clearly visible, evenly aligned, and consistent across all repeated day cells.
- The 5 routine rows must remain visually balanced and readable, with no merged cells or missing grid lines.
- The final image should look like a real photographed printable planner sheet, not a blank mockup.

- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical 2:3 printable coupon book cover and insert sheet for retail counters, membership handouts, and in-store promotional flyers.
Realistic 4-coupon grid with a polished stationery-print feel, designed to look like an actual coupon booklet page that can be cut, stamped, handed out, and used in a neighborhood retail shop.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main title {제목} is centered at the top and occupies about 15% of the frame, with strong hierarchy, a small subtitle strip, and a retail campaign masthead feel.
- Add realistic header details around the title: small Korean label text such as "회원 전용 쿠폰북", "2026년 5월호", "VOL.024", and a tiny issue/date line.
- A balanced 2x2 coupon grid fills the middle 70% of the canvas, with each panel equal in size and aligned to a strict baseline.
- Dashed perforation-style dividers run between rows and columns, visually separating the coupons like tear-off tickets; include tiny scissor icons and "CUT HERE" markers near the dashed lines.
- Each coupon panel contains the required coupon text plus supporting retail details: coupon code, validity date, short condition line, small stamp/check area, and a decorative leaf or tag icon.
- Background is soft ivory paper with fresh green accents, subtle paper grain texture, faint print fibers, light ink texture, and practical retail-stationery details.
- Add a realistic footer band with store/contact information, address line, campaign note, and a small nonfunctional barcode-style/QR-style coupon control box labeled as sample use only.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 15%): Set {제목} in large bold centered type, with clear top padding and a friendly retail-flyer masthead feel. Add small readable Korean supporting text: "회원 전용 쿠폰북", "2026.05.01 - 2026.05.31", "발행처: 그린마켓", and "VOL.024".
2. Coupon grid (center 70%): Place {쿠폰 1}, {쿠폰 2}, {쿠폰 3}, {쿠폰 4} into a 2x2 layout, each panel showing one primary benefit line, equal padding, and identical internal spacing. Under each benefit line, add realistic microcopy in Korean such as "사용 기한 2026.05.31", "1인 1회 사용", "타 쿠폰 중복 불가", and unique coupon codes "CP-0501", "CP-0502", "CP-0503", "CP-0504".
3. Divider treatment: Use thin dashed green lines between the four panels to mimic perforation, keeping the strokes precise against the ivory paper. Add tiny scissors, dotted tear tabs, and small labels "자르는 선" to make it feel like a real coupon insert.
4. Coupon panel details: Each coupon has a rounded rectangle border, soft drop shadow, pale green corner tabs, a small stamp/check box labeled "확인", and a tiny decorative icon such as a leaf, shopping bag, coffee cup, gift box, or percent tag.
5. Footer area (bottom 15%): Add a slim green border, store name line "GREEN MARKET COUPON BOOK", Korean address "서울시 중구 샘플로 27", contact "문의 02-1234-5678", website-like text "greenmarket.co.kr", and a small disclaimer line "본 쿠폰은 매장 상황에 따라 조기 종료될 수 있습니다." Include a small sample-only coupon control area, not a payment barcode.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard Bold for the title at about 48pt, and Noto Sans KR Medium for coupon text at about 24pt; use Noto Sans KR Regular at 10–14pt for coupon codes, date labels, address, and conditions. Keep line spacing tight but legible.
- Color palette: ivory #f5f5dc, medium sea green #3cb371, deep green #2f6f4e, soft paper white #fffdf7, muted leaf green #6aa84f.
- Border/shadow: Apply a soft drop shadow to each coupon block with 2px y-offset, 8px blur, 20% opacity; use thin rounded corners for a neat retail flyer finish.
- Add tactile print realism: faint paper grain, slightly imperfect ink edges, delicate green rules, small serial numbers, stamp boxes, subtle corner crop marks, and coupon-book production details.
- Decorative elements should support the coupon theme: leaf motifs, small discount tags, shopping bag icons, dotted perforation marks, and soft green header/footer bands.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Flat lay top-down composition, equivalent to a 35mm lens on a high-resolution studio setup, with an orthographic-looking presentation.
- Lighting: Soft even studio light from directly above with very mild ambient fill, no harsh directional shadows.
- Color grade: Warm ivory base with fresh green highlights and slightly muted contrast for a clean stationery-print look.
- Material rendering: convincing matte paper stock, subtle fiber texture, gentle printed-ink absorption, crisp but natural typography, and slight shadow separation between coupon blocks and background.

[6. MOOD]
Casual retail coupon flyer — like a friendly neighborhood market coupon book, a lifestyle stationery insert, and a clean supermarket promo sheet with practical real-world print details.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{제목}", "{쿠폰 1}", "{쿠폰 2}", "{쿠폰 3}", "{쿠폰 4}" must appear exactly and be fully legible.
- All four coupon blocks must use the same layout, same typography scale, and same visual treatment.
- The 2x2 coupon grid must remain balanced, with clear separation lines and consistent alignment.
- Render the added Korean text clearly: "회원 전용 쿠폰북", "2026년 5월호", "사용 기한 2026.05.31", "1인 1회 사용", "자르는 선", "확인", "문의 02-1234-5678".
- Coupon details, serial numbers, date labels, footer address, and small conditions should look like real printed retail information, while the main five placeholder texts remain the most prominent.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals/certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-1194.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean brand recruitment poster for a product experience campaign, tall 2:3 social-media announcement card.
Information-first editorial layout with a warm lifestyle-product feel, designed like a realistic Instagram recruitment card that includes campaign identity, product benefit highlights, application details, and a clear CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Portrait 2:3 layout with a clear vertical hierarchy: top intro band about 18% of frame, central hero/product card about 42%, information block about 28%, and CTA footer about 12%.
- Background is warm cream paper texture (#FFF6EE) with visible fine grain, soft peach wash, coral accent graphics (#FF7A6B / #FFD8C8), and charcoal typography (#2D2D2D) for strong contrast.
- Use a realistic editorial grid with rounded cards, layered paper slips, small sticker labels, washi-tape-like accent strips, tiny checklist marks, page indicator details, and soft shadows that make the announcement feel like a photographed printed campaign card.
- Include practical campaign micro-elements: small top label “REVIEW CREW OPEN”, issue-style tag “VOL.05”, slide indicator “01 / 03”, short Korean feature chips such as “무료 체험”, “솔직 리뷰”, “굿즈 혜택”, and a small application guide note near the details area.
- Use {브랜드명}, {제목}, {상단 문구}, {제품·서비스}, {제공 혜택}, {모집 인원}, {모집 기간}, {활동 기간}, {활동 미션}, {발표일}, {CTA}, {문의} placeholders exactly as editable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header area: place {브랜드명} small near the upper-left as a brand wordmark, add a tiny campaign label “REVIEW CREW OPEN · VOL.05” and slide indicator “01 / 03” near the upper-right, then set {제목} large and bold as the primary focal point, with {상단 문구} directly underneath in lighter weight and slightly smaller size.
2) Central hero card: create a large rounded warm-white panel occupying the middle of the poster. In the panel, show a tasteful realistic product vignette for {제품·서비스}: a candle jar or product package on cream paper, soft wax texture, a small floral sprig, matchbox, folded review note, and subtle shadow. Set {제품·서비스} as the main subject text in the center/lower part of the card, place {제공 혜택} below it as a supporting line, and add a compact rounded badge for 👥 {모집 인원} at the upper-right of the card.
3) Benefit and feature chips: around the hero panel, add small coral/peach pill tags reading “무료 체험”, “후기 선정”, “추가 굿즈”, and “콘텐츠 미션” so the card feels like a real social campaign announcement while keeping the provided benefit text dominant.
4) Information block: arrange four separated rows with tiny icon markers and clear labels, showing 📅 {모집 기간}, 🎯 {활동 기간}, 📝 {활동 미션}, and 📣 {발표일}; make each label semibold and the detail text regular for quick scanning. Add a small section heading “APPLICATION GUIDE” and a tiny note “선정자 개별 안내 / 미션 완료 후 후기 확인” as realistic microcopy.
5) CTA footer: place a coral rounded button spanning most of the width with {CTA} centered in white text, then set {문의} directly below in smaller charcoal type. Add tiny footer details such as “신청 전 필수 확인 · 제품 수령 후 기간 내 리뷰 작성” and small save/share-like micro icons to resemble a social post card.
6) Decorative accents: include coral dots, curved peach shapes, thin divider rules, subtle dashed cut lines, small sticker corners, page-number mark, and soft card shadows; keep all added decoration supportive of readability and the recruitment purpose.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; title ExtraBold 44–56px, section labels SemiBold 18–24px, supporting copy Regular 14–18px, contact line 13–15px, micro labels 10–12px.
- Color palette: cream #FFF6EE, warm white #FFFDF9, coral #FF7A6B, soft peach #FFD8C8, charcoal #2D2D2D, with tiny muted beige and warm gray accents for paper layering.
- Border/shadow: rounded corners 24px, soft drop shadow 0px 10px 24px rgba(45,45,45,0.10), CTA button shadow 0px 6px 16px rgba(255,122,107,0.24), realistic paper-edge shadows and gentle overlay grain.
- Text hierarchy must remain sharp and readable, with Korean copy aligned to a clean editorial grid and enough contrast between charcoal text and cream panels.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat editorial poster design rendered as a high-resolution digital social card, with crisp vector-like typography, realistic paper texture, layered print-card depth, and a product-vignette illustration/photo-composite look inside the hero panel.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio-like evenness, high-key design lighting, gentle contact shadows under paper layers and product objects, no harsh contrast.
- Color grade: warm cream + coral + charcoal with a gentle peach tint, polished, approachable, and realistic for a Korean lifestyle brand campaign.

[6. MOOD]
Friendly Korean brand recruitment poster with a Dazed Korea social-campaign graphic feel, similar to a polished lifestyle event announcement card for Instagram, warm and inviting but still information-rich and application-focused.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "kkott studio", "체험단 모집", "직접 써보고 솔직하게 리뷰해 주세요", "블루밍 시그니처 향초 (100ml)", "제품 무료 제공 + 체험 후기 채택 시 추가 굿즈 증정", "총 30명", "2026. 05. 01 (수) ~ 5. 07 (화) 23:59", "2026. 05. 10 ~ 5. 24 (15일)", "인스타그램 피드·릴스 1건 + 블로그 후기 1건", "2026. 05. 09 (금) 오후 — 카톡 개별 연락", "지금 바로 신청하기 →", "@kkott_studio · DM" must appear exactly and clearly.
- Additional small Korean microcopy may appear, such as “REVIEW CREW OPEN”, “VOL.05”, “01 / 03”, “무료 체험”, “솔직 리뷰”, “굿즈 혜택”, “APPLICATION GUIDE”, and “신청 전 필수 확인”, but it must not overpower the required campaign details.
- All dates, counts, mission items, and CTA wording must be legible and unbroken.
- Keep the card structure strictly vertical 2:3 with clear hierarchy between header, hero, details, and CTA.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity or influencer likeness composites

studio:prompts3:ours-1193.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Vertical onboarding explainer card for a Korean service, designed as a shareable 2:3 social card-news graphic that explains a 3-step start flow at a glance.
Realistic product-marketing layout with strong hierarchy, clear step progression, and a polished Korean tech-app guide presentation feel, suitable for Instagram carousel, in-app help center, or a launch campaign asset.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas: vertical 2:3 card with a centered content column, realistic social-card framing, and layered UI-paper surfaces.
- Top section: service name and title stacked near the upper 24% of the frame, with the subtitle tucked directly below in lighter weight.
- Add small editorial/card-news metadata around the header: a tiny pill label reading "시작 가이드", a date label "2026.05 업데이트", a page indicator "01/03", and a small handle-style credit "@service_guide".
- Central section: three rounded step cards arranged vertically with equal spacing, each card containing a large number badge, a small illustrative icon area, a right-aligned text block, and a tiny micro-label such as "STEP 01", "STEP 02", "STEP 03".
- Between cards: small downward arrows, slim chevrons, or a subtle dotted progress rail to reinforce the sequence.
- Bottom section: compact time box, fine-print notice, and a full-width CTA button aligned to the bottom with clear tap-friendly proportions.
- Add realistic card-news footer details: tiny save/share icon marks, text "저장 후 따라하기", a small help label "도움말", and a low-contrast carousel dot indicator "● ○ ○".
- Background treatment: clean white base with soft purple gradient glow on the upper-right and lower-left edges, subtle paper-smooth surface texture, faint app-window shadows, translucent lavender sticker shapes, and fine grain for a tangible digital-poster feel.
- Framing: strong centered alignment with comfortable reading distance on mobile; keep all important text inside safe areas while allowing small decorative tabs, dots, and ribbons to enrich the card.
- Use {서비스명}, {제목}, {상단 문구}, {단계 1}, {단계 2}, {단계 3}, {소요 시간}, {추가 안내}, {CTA}, {컬러 톤} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top section (top 24%):
   - Place a small top utility row with "GUIDE 01/03" on the left, "2026.05 업데이트" on the right, and a tiny lavender divider line beneath it.
   - Place {서비스명} as the primary brand line at the top center, large and bold, with tight tracking and clean spacing.
   - Place {제목} directly below it, slightly smaller but still headline-sized, with strong visual weight and tight line spacing.
   - Place {상단 문구} under the headline in smaller, lighter text, spanning no more than 70% of the card width.
   - Add a small rounded tag near the subtitle reading "3단계로 바로 시작" and a small credit line "제작 · {서비스명} 온보딩팀" in tiny gray text.
2. Central area (middle 52%):
   - Step 1 card: rounded rectangle with a large circular badge "01" on the left, a compact installation icon illustration beside it, a small label "STEP 01" above the text, and {단계 1} text block on the right; use a small downward arrow below the card to indicate continuation.
   - Step 2 card: same layout and spacing as step 1, with the badge slightly brighter or filled in purple to emphasize progression; include a compact form/input icon illustration, a small label "STEP 02", and keep {단계 2} in a clear two-line text wrap if needed.
   - Step 3 card: same layout and spacing, with a slightly more emphasized accent glow or outline to signal completion; include a launch/check icon illustration, a small label "STEP 03", and place {단계 3} prominently while keeping the mini illustration compact and readable.
   - Add a thin vertical dotted progress rail behind or beside the three cards, with small glowing nodes aligned to each badge, making the flow feel like an actual product setup timeline.
3. Bottom section (bottom 24%):
   - Place a neat time box with {소요 시간} centered, using a light border, subtle fill, and a tiny clock icon.
   - Under it, place {추가 안내} in very small gray text with tidy letter spacing and low visual weight.
   - Add a small row of helpful micro text: "저장 후 따라하기 · 친구에게 공유하기 · 문의 @service_guide" with tiny save/share/chat icons.
   - At the bottom, place a wide CTA button labeled {CTA} → with strong contrast, rounded corners, and clear tap-friendly proportions.
   - Place a tiny carousel indicator near the lower edge reading "● ○ ○" and a footer note "카드뉴스 사용법 3단계".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard for all main text, Noto Sans KR for subtitle and fine print; headers bold 700–800, body medium 500, small text regular 400; title size clearly larger than step text.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} interpreted as pure white #FFFFFF, soft lavender #DCCBFF, vivid purple #7C4DFF, deep violet #5B2EFF, charcoal #2B2B2F, light gray #9AA0A6.
- Border/shadow: each step card uses soft drop shadow 5px y-offset, 10px blur, 20% opacity; CTA button has slightly stronger shadow and a thin purple edge highlight.
- Shapes: rounded 20–24px corners, badge circles filled with a purple gradient, thin dividers, small pill labels, dotted progress nodes, translucent sticker tabs, and soft floating geometric accents.
- Icon style: simple but recognizable app-guide illustrations, using lavender outlines, purple filled details, small highlights, and consistent stroke weight.
- Include realistic micro-layout details such as tiny alignment marks, section labels, footer credits, carousel dots, and subtle UI chrome without overpowering the main three-step explanation.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: graphic design layout, no camera simulation.
- Lighting: subtle top-left highlight with soft ambient glow and faint gradient bloom around the cards, plus delicate shadow layering to make the cards feel tactile.
- Color grade: crisp white UI base with lavender-to-purple gradient accents and charcoal typography, modern app-launch presentation style.
- Surface detail: faint paper grain, soft vector gradients, polished shadows, and semi-transparent decorative overlays that create a realistic social media card-news asset.

[6. MOOD]
Modern Korean onboarding guide graphic — reminiscent of a polished Figma startup landing page, a friendly fintech app launch card, and a practical Instagram card-news tutorial saved for later.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all of the following strings must appear exactly as written:
  - {서비스명}
  - {제목}
  - {상단 문구}
  - {단계 1}
  - {단계 2}
  - {단계 3}
  - {소요 시간}
  - {추가 안내}
  - {CTA}
- Additional small Korean text may appear exactly as useful card-news details, such as "시작 가이드", "2026.05 업데이트", "3단계로 바로 시작", "저장 후 따라하기", "친구에게 공유하기", "도움말", "카드뉴스 사용법 3단계".
- Step flow clarity: show exactly 3 steps in correct order from installation to information entry to start.
- Layout invariant: each step card should contain a badge, a mini illustration, and a text block; all three cards should feel like one consistent system.
- Maintain the 1024x1536 vertical 2:3 format and keep the core purple-white palette based on {컬러 톤}.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
